title: Cloud Computing & DevOps Mastery
description: Deploy microservices with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS Cloud Services, Terraform, and automated GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.
overview: Gain hands-on expertise in automated infrastructure deployment, container orchestrations, and cloud system scaling.
learningOutcomes: Containerize applications using Docker multi-stage builds
Orchestrate resilient microservices clusters with Kubernetes (k8s)
Provision Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform and AWS

topics.title: Multi-Stage Dockerfiles & Image Optimization
topics.summary: Minimize production container image sizes and isolate build dependencies using Docker multi-stage builds.
cheatSheet: Use Alpine or Distroless base images to minimize security attack surface.
Utilize .dockerignore to exclude node_modules and build artifacts.
Label docker build stages cleanly (AS builder, AS runner).
